001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.types;
002
003import java.util.ArrayList;
004import java.util.List;
005
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
007import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.CampaignFleetAPI;
008import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.BaseSensorGhostCreator;
009import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.GhostFrequencies;
010import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhost;
011import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ghosts.SensorGhostManager;
012
013public class EchoGhostCreator extends BaseSensorGhostCreator {
014
015        @Override
016        public List<SensorGhost> createGhost(SensorGhostManager manager) {
017                if (!Global.getSector().getCurrentLocation().isHyperspace()) return null;
018                CampaignFleetAPI pf = Global.getSector().getPlayerFleet();
019                
020                List<SensorGhost> result = new ArrayList<SensorGhost>();
021                result.add(new EchoGhost(manager, pf));
022                return result;
023        }
024
025        @Override
026        public float getFrequency(SensorGhostManager manager) {
027                return GhostFrequencies.getEchoFrequency(manager);
028                //return 10000f;
029        }
030        
031        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInOrNearSlipstream() {
032                return true;
033        }
034
035        @Override
036        public boolean canSpawnWhilePlayerInAbyss() {
037                return true;
038        }
039        
040        
041}
